---
title: "{{title}}"
subtitle: "{{meeting}}"
author: "{{author}}"
date: today
lang: "{{language}}"
format:
  revealjs:
    embed-resources: true
    slide-number: true
    smaller: true
    scrollable: true
  pptx: default
params:
  dir: "../.."             # the survey (or synthesis project) folder; this file is in <dir>/outputs/<BODY>/
  body: "{{body}}"
  nets_path: ""            # leave empty to read nets_path from ~/.nets/config.json
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
nets_path <- params$nets_path
if (!nzchar(nets_path)) {
  home <- if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") Sys.getenv("USERPROFILE") else path.expand("~")
  nets_path <- jsonlite::read_json(file.path(home, ".nets", "config.json"))$nets_path
}
source(file.path(nets_path, "scripts", "nets_project.R"))

ctx <- nets_synthesis_context(params$dir, params$body)
ev <- ctx$ev
used_ids <- character()
use <- function(ids) used_ids <<- union(used_ids, ids)
v <- function(id, ...) { use(id); nets_ev_value(ev, id, ...) }
cite <- function(id, ...) { use(id); nets_ev_cite(ev, id, ...) }
```

<!--
Guidance for whoever drafts this (person or agent) — delete before sending.

* A deck presents the same evidence as the written synthesis, in fewer words: one message
  per slide, values via v()/cite() only, sources in small type. Keep uncertainty and
  limitations on their own slide; do not drop them for brevity.
* Several surveys: ids are "<survey_id>/E###"; cross-survey values are D###.
* Render to HTML (reveal.js) or PowerPoint with scripts/nets_render.R, then run the release
  check on the .qmd AND on every rendered file.
-->

    knitr::kable(tibble::tibble(Estimate = purrr::map_chr(ids, ~ nets_ev_row(ev, .x)$claim),
                                Value = purrr::map_chr(ids, ~ v(.x, uncertainty = TRUE)),
                                Source = purrr::map_chr(ids, cite)))
-->

`r nets_clearance_statement(ctx)`

## Evidence used

```{r}
#| label: evidence-annex
if (length(used_ids)) {
  knitr::kable(nets_ev_annex(ev, sort(used_ids))[, c("ID", "Value", "Source")])
} else {
  cat("No evidence ids were used.")
}
```
